profile.legalName: East Bay Consortium of Educational Institutions, Inc.
profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that works to increase the number of students who finish high school and enroll in college. It is one of fifteen California Student Opportunity and Access Projects (Cal-SOAP) run through the California Student Aid Commission. It offers summer enrichment, tutoring, mentoring, and college and financial aid guidance for students, plus training for teachers.
